transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Ever since that accident at the warehouse, I can’t get a full night’s sleep and I wake up over and over, completely drained the next day. I'm just so exhausted all the time now and really need some help with it.
Since the accident, do you find yourself having recurring, distressing dreams about the event, or do you try to avoid reminders of what happened?

Yes, both of those are happening. When I do manage to sleep, I keep waking up from terrible half-dreams of the metal crashing down and my coworker screaming. At work, I actively avoid the aisle where the collapse happened and dread my shift changes just to keep from being reminded of it.
Since the accident, have you felt constantly on edge, easily startled, or physically jumpy, even when you are not at work?

Yes, I feel constantly on edge and jumpy no matter where I am. At work, I'm always checking the racks above me and I jump out of my skin every time a pallet drops. Even at home, I find myself scanning the room and tensing up at every little noise like something bad is about to happen.
